The two-judge bench, presided by Justice Surya Kant, was responding to submissions by petitioners, including NGO Association for Democratic Rights(ADR), that the additional 3.66 lakh voters who were deleted in the final list - in addition to the 65 lakh deleted in the draft list - had not been given individual notices. The final electoral roll published on September 30 has 7.42 crore voters.
